name: Iron Cobra
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can’t speak

traits.name: Find Target
traits.text:
The iron cobra knows the location
of a specific target creature as long as that creature
is within 1 mile of it. If the creature is moving, it
knows the direction if that creature’s movement.
If the target is beyond this distance, the iron cobra
can’t locate the target creature.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.text:
The iron cobra is immune to any
spell or effect that would alter its form.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The iron cobra has advantage on
saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapon
traits.text:
The iron cobra’s weapon attacks
are magical.

traits.name: Poison
traits.text:
The iron cobra contains enough venom
for three attacks. After that, it does not deal the poison
damage listed in its bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 11 Constitution
saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed saving throw, or
half as much damage on a successful one.
